story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Existing date identification and Facets population capability remain available for inbound 834 processing

flagged.why: wrong date mapping in test data

gaps: Pre-condition contains "Effective Date in Loop 2000 DTP*348"; contradicts hint "Eligibility Date = Loop 2000 DTP*356/DTP*348. Assessment Date = Loop 2300 HD03. Maintenance Date = Loop 2000 DTP*303. Never name a date by a bare element position such as DTP01 or DTP03."

Step Description step 1 contains "Loop 2000 DTP*348 Effective Date = 20250201"; contradicts hint "Eligibility Date = Loop 2000 DTP*356/DTP*348. Assessment Date = Loop 2300 HD03. Maintenance Date = Loop 2000 DTP*303. Never name a date by a bare element position such as DTP01 or DTP03."

scenarios.title: New enrollment uses Eligibility Date when eligibility span has not yet begun
Current eligibility change uses Assessment Date when Assessment Date changes
Assessment Date change with no relevant field changes keeps field values and uses Assessment Date

flagged.why: missing test cases for the listed condition

gaps: Scenario TS_004 description field includes only one listed condition: "Conditions to cover: 1) Assessment Date changes while the relevant fields are unchanged, and Assessment Date becomes the transaction effective date with no unintended field value changes." The table provides only one test case id, "TC_001", but "{"passscore": 90, "stepsmin": 7, "stepsmax": 18, "testcasesperscenario": 6}" indicates 6 test cases were to be produced; TS_004 also requires "Conditions to cover: 1) Assessment Date changes while the relevant fields are unchanged, and Assessment Date becomes the transaction effective date with no unintended field value changes." add dedicated test cases for the remaining planned coverage.

scenarios.title: Future eligibility field changes with unchanged Assessment Date use Eligibility Date
Current eligibility field changes with unchanged Assessment Date use Maintenance Date only after eligibility start
Maintenance Date is not used outside its allowed rule path
